intro_html: Creamy chicken and mushrooms is the kind of stick-to-your-ribs meal that usually comes from a can of soup and a lot of sodium. This slow cooker version does it from scratch, landing at 63 grams of protein for about $3.71 a serving (at everyday cost). Fourteen servings means the good stuff feeds you all week for the price of one restaurant plate.
cost_closing_html: About $3.71 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each serving delivers 63 grams of protein and 568 calories, creamy comfort without the calorie blowout.
upsell_html: Made from scratch, easy on salt, and heavy on protein. Your future self will thank you. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Whole white mushrooms are usually cheaper than pre-sliced, so buy them whole and slice them yourself in two minutes.
Greek yogurt plus a little cream cheese replaces cans of condensed soup, so skip the canned soup aisle and cut the sodium too.
Garlic powder is far cheaper than fresh for a dish this size, so keep a jar in the rack and season with a free hand.
make_it: Add the chicken, sliced mushrooms, chicken broth, cream cheese, and garlic powder to the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 6 to 7 hours until the chicken is tender and the mushrooms are soft.
Shred the chicken and stir everything so the cream cheese melts into a smooth sauce.
Stir in the Greek yogurt off the heat to keep the sauce creamy and tangy.
Spoon the creamy chicken and mushrooms over white rice.
